concerns.text: The specification requires downloading public AM alloy datasets that include alloy composition, yet the functional requirements and modeling pipeline (FR-003, FR-006) do not describe any strategy to account for alloy composition or other latent confounding variables (e.g., microstructural state). Without controlling or explicitly modeling these confounds, inferred correlations between processing parameters and mechanical properties may be spurious, violating construct validity.

Success Criterion SC-004 proposes measuring the correlation between permutation‑importance rankings and a “user‑provided JSON ranking of expected parameter influence (or a published literature baseline)”. If the user‑provided ranking is derived from the same dataset or model, the validation becomes circular. The spec must require that the reference ranking be independent of the data used to train the GPR model (e.g., from prior literature or separate experiments).
